description: Commit changed, new or deleted files ({ path, delete: true }) to a repository the workspace's git connection reaches, as one commit on a branch (default: the repository's default branch). An application deploying that branch with auto-deploy redeploys on its own; otherwise call deploy-application. Overwrites the files given; confirm with the user before deleting files.

content.description: The file's content: text, or base64 with encoding 'base64'

encoding.description: 'base64' for binary files such as images; default utf8

path.description: Path inside the repository, e.g. 'index.html' or 'src/app.js'

owner.description: Account, organisation, group or workspace that owns the repository

name: commit-files
